facts.text: Kimpton Vividora is the first Kimpton in Spain and is located in the Gothic Quarter.
facts.excerpt: Kimpton Vividora, the first Kimpton in Spain, is located in the Gothic Quarter

facts.text: The hotel sits right next to Las Ramblas and within walking distance of Barceloneta beach.
facts.excerpt: The hotel sits right next to Las Ramblas and is within walking distance of the Barceloneta beach.

facts.text: The hotel is on a pedestrian street in the city center.
facts.excerpt: Tucked away on a pedestrian street in Barcelona

facts.text: The hotel offers complimentary bikes and longboards for guests to explore the city.
facts.excerpt: discover the city with our complimentary bikes and longboards

facts.text: A Social Hour with complimentary drinks takes place every day on the ground floor.
facts.excerpt: Join our Social Hour every day on the ground floor. Enjoy complimentary drinks in a relaxed, vibrant setting

facts.text: Pets of any size, weight or breed are welcome at no extra charge.
facts.excerpt: No matter their size, weight or breed and with no extra charge.

facts.text: Pets receive an in-room welcome kit with a bed, toys and treats.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a special in-room welcome kit with a cozy bed, toys, and tasty treats

facts.text: Terraza de Vivi is a rooftop terrace and bar with views over the city, serving cocktails with live music by local artists.
facts.excerpt: this beautifully designed rooftop terrace and bar has striking views over the city and serves innovative cocktails paired with live music played by local artists.

facts.text: The outdoor pool is next to Terraza de Vivi, the hotel's terrace and bar.
facts.excerpt: Adjacent to Terraza de Vivi, our terrace and bar, you can opt for a refreshing dip
Our non-heated pool is located adjacent to Terraza de Vivi, our terrace and bar.

facts.text: Fauna restaurant serves Mediterranean flavours with Catalan roots, by chef Jordi Delfa.
facts.excerpt: traditional cuisine with an innovative touch by chef Jordi Delfa.

facts.text: Terraza de Vivi serves a brunch with bottomless mimosas and Bloody Marys.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a delicious variety of dishes, bottomless mimosas and Bloody Marys

facts.text: GOT Coffee & Cocktails is a cafe by day that becomes a bar with natural wines, artisanal vermouth and cocktails at night.
facts.excerpt: A bustling café by day, that transitions into night with natural wines, artisanal vermouth, and clever cocktails.

facts.text: The fitness room is equipped with Technogym.
facts.excerpt: a modern gym fully equipped with Technogym

facts.text: The hotel has a Wellness Room curated by Signature Spa.
facts.excerpt: Discover the Kimpton Vividora Wellness Room, curated by Signature Spa.

facts.text: Rooms use a Mediterranean color palette, natural materials and design pieces from local artisans.
facts.excerpt: A breezy Mediterranean color palette accented with luxe natural materials and artful design pieces from local artisans

facts.text: Guest parking is off-site at Saba Car Park on Plaza de Catalunya, at an additional cost.
facts.excerpt: Parking is available for hotel guests at Saba Car Park on Plaza de Catalunya with an additional cost.

facts.text: The hotel has no local area shuttle.
facts.excerpt: There is no local area shuttle available at this hotel.
